comment.body: Thanks for checking both startup locations and restarting; those questions have already been answered. The next discriminator is the instance that actually remains: in Task Manager locate PowerToys.exe, choose Open file location, and inspect its file Properties. Please report its file version and whether it is under your per-user application folder, Program Files, or another location; omit your username/full personal path. This lets us correlate the binary with the correct installation registration instead of assuming a local build or recommending deletion of folders.
